notes.slice1_folio: StudioCompositionMask gains feather / opacity / expansion: Option<StudioKeyedValue> (existing static_value + keyframes record, no new type), serde default + skip_serializing_if none, deny_unknown_fields kept. Ranges: feather 2 components each 0..=MAX_STREAM_ABS_VALUE (folio's coordinate bound; pigment's 10000 px feather limit is enforced as a typed refusal in composite, not in Folio), opacity 1 component 0..=1 (stored form, STU-CMP-026), expansion 1 component |x| <= MAX_STREAM_ABS_VALUE. validate_mask runs validate_keyed per stream (target <layer>/masks/<id>/<stream>/...). New const StudioCompositionMask::FEATHER_COMPONENTS = 2. track_apply literal: fields None (a planar-track re-apply replaces an existing mask with the streams absent, as it already resets inverted: follow-up candidate, not changed). Existing folio test mask_path_contract.rs still sets masks[0].feather = 2.0 and expects a decode error: still refused (a number is not a StudioKeyedValue), its message 'unknown fields are refused' is now stale wording (file not owned).
notes.slice2_composite: mask_paths additive: MaskShape {feather_px [x,y], opacity, expansion_px} (Default = identity), MaskShapeRefusal {mask index, code}, codes composition_mask_feather_out_of_range / composition_mask_opacity_not_finite / composition_mask_expansion_geometry, MASK_EXPANSION_TOLERANCE_PX = 1e-3, mask_coverage_shaped. Readings declared in the module rustdoc (UNVERIFIED vs After Effects, D5): order expansion -> coverage over rect grown by feather_support -> separable feather_kernel (x then y, cropped, no border clamp reached) -> invert -> opacity -> combine; expansion in LAYER space before the matrix (nib edit::offset_path, round join, polygon mapped by the matrix; 0 skips the offset); feather in plane pixels along plane axes, radius = feather value (pigment sigma = r/2, support ceil(3 sigma), the Photoshop vector-mask feather maths); sampled overshoot clamped (opacity 0..1, negative feather 0); non-finite or > MAX_FEATHER_PX typed. MaskAtTick and mask_coverage unchanged; masked_scene.rs untouched.
notes.slice3_temporal: LayerMasks.masks: Vec<LayerMask {mask_id, mode, inverted, closed, path, feather, opacity, expansion}> (was a tuple); LayerMasks::at samples every stream with motion sample (same property()/keyed_property conversion as the path); LayerMasks::coverage calls mask_coverage_shaped; used at the 3D plane site, the 2D composition matte site and effects.rs. Plane bound: max(rect pixels, vector::MAX_CLIP_PIXELS) so a feather's support fits; identity masks see the same bound outcome as before. Refusal = TemporalError::Unsupported { layer_id: '<layer>/masks/<mask_id>', feature: code }. The 3D plane site is wired but has no dedicated test in this lane.
